grammar.title: Cohesive Devices & Linking Words (Conectivos para Redação Acadêmica)
rules: Use "furthermore/moreover/in addition" para adicionar uma ideia que reforça o argumento anterior: Furthermore, the data supports this conclusion.
Use "however/nevertheless/nonetheless" para introduzir contraste: Nevertheless, some experts disagree with the findings.
Use "consequently/therefore/as a result" para indicar causa e efeito: Consequently, the government introduced new policies.
Use "whereas/while/in contrast" para comparar duas ideias opostas na mesma frase: Whereas urban areas have grown, rural populations have declined.
